title: CIF onboarding acceptance framework and handoff readiness
workflow: Map CIF-001..019 candidate controls and schemas to source requirements
Review country/institution identity policies, privacy, KYC/KYB and risk sources
Agree state machines, access roles, APIs, event contracts and retention policies
Build and execute positive, negative, concurrency and cross-institution tests in controlled environment
Require qualified compliance, security, operations, legal and QA evidence-based reviews
Approve only bounded functions that satisfy their full 15-point Definition of Ready and specific acceptance evidence
requirements: Do not mark 20 CIF design checkpoints as 20 completed reviewed work packages
Onboarding API must enforce identity/risk/approval restrictions before customer activation
Account and payments contexts remain separate and retain their independent legal/accounting gates
Any missing binding local KYC rule or unauthorized source leaves dependent capability blocked
Final approval must cite exact Git revision, test logs, reviewer identity and institution profile
Document-only acceptance is different from tested implementation and go-live certification
test_cases: Audit every CIF package for assigned reviewer and accepted criteria
Demonstrate prohibited case approval fails all supported UI/API paths
Test cross-tenant access, stale mandates and disputed identity
Prove case replay does not create duplicate customer relationship
Produce final run evidence bundle with no synthetic pass claims
closure_gate: Full historic WBS crosswalk, approved local KYC/legal profile, executable evidence, assigned reviewers and separate release approval.
